stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja como foi o 42º dia de campanha dos candidatos ao governo do Amapá

en.title: 2026 Elections: see how the 42nd day of campaigning went for candidates for governor of Amapá
en.summary: Candidates for Amapá governor completed their 42nd official campaign day on Saturday, engaging in interviews, meetings, neighborhood visits, and other activities. The first round of elections is scheduled for October 4, 2026.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro volta a chamar Lula de 'pai do Tigrinho' após MP que proíbe bets

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro again calls Lula 'father of Tigrinho' after MP banning bets
en.summary: The PL candidate for president labeled the sitting president using terms referencing gambling and betting games at a campaign event. The statement came a day after the government issued a provisional measure prohibiting betting platforms.

stories.title: Corinthians sai na frente, mas São Paulo busca virada na 1ª final do Brasileiro feminino

en.title: Corinthians takes the lead, but São Paulo seeks comeback in 1st final of women's Brasileirão
en.summary: Corinthians and São Paulo compete in the first match of the women's Brasileirão final, with one team taking an initial advantage.

stories.title: São Paulo bate Corinthians em Itaquera e larga na frente na decisão do Brasileiro feminino

en.title: São Paulo beats Corinthians at Itaquera and takes the lead in women's Brasileirão final
en.summary: São Paulo won 2-1 against Corinthians in the first leg of the women's Brasileirão final, coming from behind to secure the advantage heading into the second match.

stories.title: 37% avaliam Congresso como ruim ou péssimo, aponta Datafolha; 18% dizem que desempenho é ótimo ou bom

en.title: 37% rate Congress as bad or very bad, points to Datafolha; 18% say performance is excellent or good
en.summary: A Datafolha survey found that 37% of Brazilian voters consider the work of federal senators and deputies to be bad or very bad, while 18% rate their performance as excellent or good. The poll interviewed 2,002 voters aged 16 or older across 125 municipalities on September 22-23, 2026.

stories.title: Espanha mostra embalo após Copa e ganha da Inglaterra em jogaço de reviravoltas na Liga das Nações

en.title: Spain shows momentum after Cup and beats England in exciting turnaround match in Nations League
en.summary: Spain defeated England in a Nations League match characterized by multiple comeback moments, continuing strong form following the Cup competition.

stories.title: Datafolha: 37% avaliam o Congresso Nacional como ruim ou péssimo e 18% como ótimo ou bom

en.title: Datafolha: 37% rate National Congress as bad or very bad and 18% as excellent or good
en.summary: A Datafolha poll released on September 26, 2026, shows that 37% of voters assess the National Congress as bad or very bad, while 18% rate it as excellent or good, less than a week before elections.

stories.title: BH: Aeroporto de Confins suspende operações por problema na pista

en.title: BH: Confins Airport suspends operations due to runway problem
en.summary: Belo Horizonte's Confins International Airport suspended all landing and takeoff operations on September 26 due to a runway issue, with no estimated timeline for resumption of normal operations.

en.title: Corinthians vs São Paulo in Brasileirão Feminino final: where to watch live, time and lineup
en.summary: Corinthians and São Paulo will face each other in the final of the women's Brazilian championship, with details provided about broadcast options and match information.

stories.title: Mais da metade dos candidatos de 2022 mudou de partido para as eleições de 2026

en.title: More than half of 2022 candidates changed parties for 2026 elections
en.summary: A majority of candidates who ran in 2022 switched to different political parties before the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: saiba em quantos candidatos votar e a ordem de votação

en.title: 2026 Elections: learn how many candidates to vote for and voting order
en.summary: Voters in the 2026 elections can choose up to six candidates, with different digit sequences required for each position: 4 for federal deputy, 5 for state deputy, 3 for senator, and 2 for governor and president.

stories.title: Em jogo com duas viradas, Espanha vence Inglaterra (3-2) na Liga das Nações

en.title: In a match with two comebacks, Spain defeats England (3-2) in Nations League
en.summary: World champion Spain beat England 3-2 at Wembley Stadium in London during the first round of the Uefa Nations League on Saturday.

stories.title: EUA vão estabelecer padrões menos rigorosos de consumo de combustível

en.title: USA to establish less stringent fuel consumption standards
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation will formalize significantly less strict vehicle fuel consumption standards through 2031 on Monday, reversing the Biden administration's push for automakers to produce more electric vehicles. President Trump stated the new standards would reduce prices for new vehicles.

stories.title: Em Michigan, republicanos tentam retratar democratas como extremistas

en.title: In Michigan, Republicans attempt to portray Democrats as extremists
en.summary: Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers is being characterized as a moderate conservative against his Democratic opponent Abdul El-Sayed, who is depicted as a socialist favoring big government aligned with the party's left wing.

stories.title: Como a Converse poderia ter evitado o anúncio que foi obrigada a retirar do ar

en.title: How Converse could have avoided the ad it was forced to remove
en.summary: Nike's Converse withdrew a Chuck 70 X sneaker campaign after social media users identified imagery resembling the Ku Klux Klan. The company apologized and acknowledged making an error.

stories.title: Governo prepara reunião com clubes para tentar conter revolta no futebol com fim das bets

en.title: Government prepares meeting with clubs to attempt to contain football revolt over betting ban
en.summary: The Lula government will convene football clubs next week to discuss potential assistance for teams affected by a provisional measure prohibiting betting sites nationwide. Officials aim to diagnose the situation before determining appropriate responses.

stories.title: Buraco em pista provoca cancelamentos e atrasos de voos do aeroporto de Confins (MG)

en.title: Runway hole causes flight cancellations and delays at Confins airport (MG)
en.summary: A hole in the runway at Belo Horizonte International Airport in Confins, Minas Gerais caused flight cancellations and delays on Saturday. Airport operations were temporarily suspended for repairs, with the runway reopened after work was completed.
